mainEntity.name: Can AI prospect research work with the CRM I already use?

acceptedAnswer.text: A CRM can remain the system of record while AI handles research, summaries, scoring suggestions, and draft preparation. Avoid creating a second disconnected database unless you have a clear reason. Define which fields AI may update, how duplicates are handled, and when a human must approve changes. Begin with one integration and test records before syncing a full database. Run My AI Biz’s coordinated-assistant approach is most useful when each tool’s responsibility and handoff are explicit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Usually, if the tools support compatible imports, exports, or integrations. Keep the CRM as the main record, define permitted updates, prevent duplicates, and test a small batch first. Add complexity only after the basic handoff works reliably.
